Every mimid KeyPackage (consent grant, keyMaterial success) is refused by Haven's gate mimi_gate_keypackage with KeyPackageValidation(UnsupportedExtension). mimid follows RFC 9420 §10 (L3520-3525: KeyPackage extensions listed in leaf capabilities; creator SHOULD include GREASE extensions; unknown ones MUST be ignored) and §13.5 (L5140-5150: KeyPackage.extensions may carry GREASE); it lists its GREASE extension type in capabilities (crates/mimi-mls/src/identity.rs key_package). Cause, verified in openmls-0.8.1 source: capabilities parse a GREASE value as ExtensionType::Grease(x) (extensions/mod.rs:242) but a KeyPackage Extension::Unknown(x) reports ExtensionType::Unknown(x) (mod.rs:754), so KeyPackageIn::validate (key_packages/key_package_in.rs:185-191) finds it unsupported. Fixed upstream by openmls #2162 (merged to main 2026-09-21, not in 0.9.2; mimid's fork carries it as 4e26ec5d1). Blocks the live keyMaterial/consent lane (B4, mimid-1wgh.46.1.6). Framing is otherwise fine: the same messages built by mimid around a Haven-minted KeyPackage decode and re-encode identically.
